content.value_statement: Complex LLM applications need clear patterns for agents, retrieval, memory, and monitoring. This skill provides practical LangChain architecture guidance and production checks.
actual_capabilities: Explains agents, chains, memory, document processing, and callbacks.
Provides example patterns for retrieval, custom tools, and sequential chains.
Compares memory approaches for short, long, windowed, entity, and vector contexts.
Shows callback patterns for logging, monitoring, and error handling.
Outlines testing, caching, batch processing, streaming, and production checks.
limitations: Examples use older LangChain APIs and may require migration for current releases.
The skill provides guidance and examples but does not execute or deploy applications.
Referenced resource and asset files are not included in this package.
Environment-specific security, costs, credentials, and service limits still require validation.

use_cases.title: Plan a retrieval application
use_cases.description: Define document loading, chunking, embeddings, storage, retrieval, and source-return requirements.
use_cases.target_user: Application developers building document question-answering systems

use_cases.title: Review an agent design
use_cases.description: Assess tool descriptions, memory selection, error handling, timeouts, validation, and observability.

use_cases.title: Prepare production safeguards
use_cases.description: Create a checklist for testing, token monitoring, rate limits, fallbacks, prompt versions, and callbacks.

prompt_templates.title: Choose core components
prompt_templates.prompt: Recommend LangChain components for [application], considering inputs, outputs, data sources, conversation length, and deployment constraints.

prompt_templates.title: Design a retrieval flow
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a LangChain retrieval workflow for [documents] and [queries], including chunking, embeddings, storage, retrieval, citations, and evaluation.

prompt_templates.title: Review an agent
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this LangChain agent design: [design]. Identify tool, memory, validation, timeout, error-handling, logging, and testing gaps.

prompt_templates.title: Create a production architecture
prompt_templates.prompt: Produce a production LangChain architecture for [requirements], covering orchestration, retrieval, state, observability, scaling, security boundaries, failure recovery, and verification.

output_examples.input: Choose memory for a support assistant with long conversations and limited context.
output_examples.output: Use summarized history for older messages and a short recent-message window. Test summary accuracy, token growth, and sensitive-data retention.

output_examples.input: Review a retrieval application before production.
output: Validate chunk size and overlap against representative questions.
Measure retrieval relevance and answer grounding.
Return sources and monitor latency, tokens, failures, and costs.

output_examples.input: Plan safeguards for an agent that can search and send email.
output_examples.output: Restrict tool inputs, require confirmation before sending, apply timeouts and rate limits, log decisions safely, and test failure paths.

best_practices: Clarify inputs, tools, permissions, state, constraints, and success measures before selecting components.
Validate retrieval, prompts, tool calls, and memory behavior with representative tests.
Add timeouts, rate limits, safe logging, error handling, monitoring, and fallback paths before production.
anti_patterns: Do not give agents broad tool access without validation and permission boundaries.
Do not retain unlimited conversation history or sensitive data without a retention policy.
Do not deploy examples unchanged without checking current LangChain APIs and environment requirements.

faq.question: Which LangChain topics does this skill cover?
faq.answer: It covers agents, chains, memory, retrieval, document processing, callbacks, testing, performance, and production checks.

faq.question: Does this skill install LangChain or run code?
faq.answer: No. It provides architecture guidance and Python examples for adaptation in your environment.

faq.question: Are the examples compatible with current LangChain releases?
faq.answer: Some examples use older interfaces. Confirm imports and migration guidance against your installed version.

faq.question: Can it help select a memory strategy?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares buffer, summary, window, entity, and vector retrieval memory patterns.

faq.question: Does it include production security controls?
faq.answer: It identifies validation, timeouts, rate limits, logging, testing, and permission boundaries, but implementation remains environment-specific.

faq.question: Are the referenced supporting files included?
faq.answer: No. The audited package contains only SKILL.md, so listed resources and assets are unavailable.
